content:
Hi, This is my first contribution to CSLib.

I formalized union find (union by rank). I saw it listed in CONTRIBUTING under "verified
data structures with time complexity". It proves find runs in O(log n) and that union by
rank preserves the invariants, with the cost tracked through TimeM like MergeSort does.

I put the whole thing in one PR: https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/695

I also broke it into smaller PRs in case that is easier to review:

  • findDepth + termination: https://github.com/barni120400/cslib/pull/2
  • the O(log n) bound, findDepth_le_log: https://github.com/barni120400/cslib/pull/3
  • link (union by rank) + reachability helpers: https://github.com/barni120400/cslib/pull/4
  • subtree-size lemmas: https://github.com/barni120400/cslib/pull/5
  • link_wellFormed: https://github.com/barni120400/cslib/pull/6
  • timed find (TimeM): https://github.com/barni120400/cslib/pull/7
  • tests: https://github.com/barni120400/cslib/pull/8

Would you prefer the single PR or the split? No path compression yet, just the union by
rank bound. I used a mix of Claude Code and writing the proofs myself. Any feedback on
placement or what to change would be very welcome, and of course I would like to have a CR.
Thanks!
